summary.text: Marilyn Stark is a Republican member of the Oklahoma House of Representatives who has represented District 100 since November 2018 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election.
The Republican primary was canceled, and Democrat Chaunté Gilmore is also on the general election ballot.

paragraphs.text: Marilyn Stark assumed office on November 21, 2018, succeeding Elise Hall.
For 2025-2026 she was assigned to the Administrative Rules Committee, the Select Committee to Review Mental Health Finances and the Health and Human Services Oversight Committee.
In earlier terms she was vice chair of the Health Services and Long-Term Care Committee.

In a Ballotpedia survey during her 2018 campaign, Stark listed her top priorities as fully funding education, transparency and accountability in agencies and government spending, and a group of issues including mental health, substance abuse, child welfare, domestic violence and prison reform.
She said she comes from a nursing and non-profit background.
